taglines: Wednesday. Peak week. The exact moment where Monday feels distant and Friday is still a rumor. You are here. You made it to the middle. Cope.
Someone just scheduled a 4:30 PM meeting. On a Wednesday. They are the villain. They know they are the villain. They scheduled it anyway.
You deployed at 4 PM on a hump day. Bold. Unhinged. The smoke detector in the server room respects you. Nobody else does yet.
Your standup was 22 minutes and exactly zero blockers got resolved. You all agreed to sync async. The sync never happened. It never will.
The Jira ticket said 'small fix.' The small fix touched 14 files, rewrote a core abstraction, and now requires a migration. Enjoy your evening.
Midweek clarity: you are not behind on your tasks, you are ahead of your future burnout. It will catch up. It always catches up. Hydrate.
Someone pushed directly to main and whispered 'it's fine' to no one in particular. The CI is red. It is not fine. Godspeed.
You have 11 unread Slack messages, 3 of which are urgent, 2 of which are memes, and 1 of which is you accidentally DMing yourself. Wednesday is undefeated.
